objective: Search for a product and sort the results by price on Amazon.

steps.title: Search for a product
steps.action: Enter the product name in the search bar and submit the search.
steps.expected_result: Search results for the product are displayed.

steps.title: Sort by price
steps.action: Select the option to sort the results by price.
steps.expected_result: Search results are sorted by price.

success_criteria: Search results for the product are displayed.
Search results are sorted by price.
